# Spoils {faction="player" kicker="What you take"}

Faction buildings and units leave salvage you cannot make yourself. Salvage builds a barracks for your army and unlocks
technologies taken from the factions' own designs.

## Wrecks

When a faction building or unit with salvage is destroyed, what it leaves goes into a wreck on the spot. Mine the wreck
by hand, or mark it for deconstruction and your robots bring everything back at once. A wreck disappears after
{{< var spoils.wreck_min >}} minutes.

## What drops where

{{< include _generated/salvage.qmd >}}

A few more things are worth taking:

- **Grubstake yard.** Holds what Grubstake has stolen and drops its contents when destroyed, so you get your own goods
  back.
- **Destroyed bases.** When a faction base loses its lander, its outposts can be captured and its ruins mined.

The corporations salvage too. Grubstake can research salvage, and once it has, what it destroys funds its research.

## Faction technologies

The component technologies are researched by crafting something, without science packs. Salvage disassembles into a
*parts* item (Pheromone gland parts, Rail coil parts and so on), and crafting that item for the first time completes
the research. The parts recipes are available from the start. Field studies (below) are earned by fighting.

```{=latex}
\clearpage
```

::: {.tree tree="player-techs-early"}
Each column is where a technology comes from; each band is the most advanced science pack on the way to it. The badge
says how you get it. Arrows mark the faction technologies that need another. The tree goes on from chemical science.
:::

::: {.tree tree="player-techs-late"}
From chemical science on. *Other worlds* holds the technologies that wait for a Space Age technology researched with
another planet's science pack.
:::

### What they give you

**From Grubstake** (pheromone glands also drop from Synthexis incubators):

- **Pheromone bait.** {{< var desc.entity_player_bait >}}
- **Pact breaker.** {{< var desc.entity_pact_breaker >}}
- **Claim marker.** {{< var desc.entity_claim_marker >}}

**From Kessler-Hayashi:**

- **Rail rifle.** {{< var desc.item_rail_rifle >}}
- **Cluster artillery shell.** {{< var desc.item_cluster_artillery_shell >}}
- **Orbital strike beacon.** {{< var desc.entity_strike_beacon >}} Once charged it paints its ground for
  {{< var spoils.strike_paint_s >}} seconds, the orbital platform's shadow crosses, and lances fall on every biter nest,
  worm, corporation building and Synthexis incubator, biochamber, tumor and clinic in that
  reach, nearest the beacon first, as many on each as it takes. Walls, gates, poles and
  units are spared. The beacon is spent as the first lance falls. A strike on Grubstake's buildings provokes it like
  any other damage.

## Field studies

Fighting a corporation teaches you about it. Destroy enough of the right things and a **field study** completes on its
own: the research screen shows each study with what it asks for. A completed study opens a technology you research
with science packs as usual. Kills by your turrets and artillery count as well as your own and your army's. Once a
study is done, further kills of that kind give nothing more.

**From Grubstake:**

- **Claims register.** {{< var desc.technology_claims_register >}}
- **Strip drill.** {{< var desc.technology_strip_drill >}}
- **Pheromone bait, made.** {{< var desc.technology_bait_made >}}
- **Flak turret.** {{< var desc.technology_flak_turret >}}

**From Synthexis:**

- **Bred-biter telemetry.** {{< var desc.technology_bred_telemetry >}}
- **Defoliant.** {{< var desc.technology_defoliant >}}
- **Incubator capture.** {{< var desc.technology_incubator_capture >}}

The table above gives what each study asks for and what its technology costs.

**Field dome.** {{< var desc.entity_player_dome >}} You research it with science packs; it needs no study. See
[Your army](army.qmd).

**Prizes.** Destroy a corporation's uplink and it withdraws (see [Arrivals](arrivals.qmd)). You get its prize
technology at once: Kessler-Hayashi's mortar, or Grubstake's strip drill.

- **Mortar.** {{< var desc.entity_player_mortar >}}
- **Strip drill.** {{< var desc.entity_strip_drill >}}

## Command cores

A barracks costs a command core. **Command bandwidth 1** gives you your first one. The rest come from faction wreckage:
{{< var spoils.core_depot >}} from a destroyed depot, {{< var spoils.core_lander >}} from a lander,
{{< var spoils.core_capture >}} from a captured outpost, and {{< var spoils.core_survey >}} from Grubstake's survey party. See [Your army](army.qmd).
